scope: Bicycles and framesets relevant to riders in mainland China, with emphasis on useful China-market comparisons, strong value, and well-sourced technical data.
buyer_note: Prices are dated observations or reference ranges, not live quotes. Verify the exact SKU, sizing and geometry, component substitutions, compatibility, serial number, return terms, and warranty before paying.
privacy: The dataset contains public product information, anonymized market observations, remote product-image URLs and credits, and original project placeholders only. It contains no buyer identity, account details, private messages, private screenshots, or personal permission correspondence.

frameset_build_assumption.label: 105 Di2-oriented standard build
frameset_build_assumption.summary: An adjustable total allowance for the drivetrain, wheels, tires, contact points and assembly still needed after the recorded frame package; parts already included in that package remain in the frame price.

presets.label: Ultegra Di2 plan
presets.basis: Reviewed default plus the upper ¥1,900 R8170-versus-R7170 dealer-market premium in the supplied August 2026 synthesis

presets.label: Magene QED plan
presets.basis: No attributable mainland consumer price is recorded, so enter a complete remaining-build allowance rather than inferring one from the catalog package

presets.label: WheelTop EDS TX 2× plan
